entities.summary: Zapateado is a style of dance and traditional music of Andalusian origins in metre 68, with lively movement, marked on two beats, the second being very stressed. The dance shows a gracious tapping. Humanists of 16th century affirmed that zapateado derived from the lactisma of the Roman dancers in times of the Empire.
